סָבִיב takes the whole compound adverbial *round about*, headed on *round*, the word carrying the lexeme (rules 24, 30); the two words are one rendering of which no morpheme owns a part, so the following lamed has no claim on *about*. Splitting the pair, with *about* going to לַ, was the competing reading and is what this verse first took; the corpus reads סָבִיב as *round about* headed on *round* in 144 units and as a bare *round* in two, one hedged and one a doubled adverb, and gives the adverb the whole compound in four of the five units where a determined preposition follows it. EXO.40.8 is read the same way.
